  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'

SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.member_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.standard_cost, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dups d USING (receipt_id, line_no)
ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 24

WITH dups AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no, count(*) c, count(DISTINCT sale_date) dd, count(DISTINCT store_key) ds, count(DISTINCT net_amount) dn, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) de, min(sales_line_id) mn, max(sales_line_id) mx FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
SELECT c, dd, ds, dn, de, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN mx-mn=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) adjacent FROM dups GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

calls.statement:
WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
raw_sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS s FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
ded_sales AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS s FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
ded_ret AS (
  SELECT s.store_id, SUM(r.refund_net) AS r FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales_before_returns) AS b, SUM(returns_net) AS rn, SUM(net_sales) AS n FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rpt.store_id, raw_sales.s AS raw_before, ded_sales.s AS ded_before, rpt.b AS rpt_before, ded_ret.r AS ded_ret, rpt.rn AS rpt_ret, ded_sales.s-coalesce(ded_ret.r,0) AS ded_net, rpt.n AS rpt_net
FROM rpt LEFT JOIN raw_sales USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN ded_sales USING(store_id) LEFT JOIN ded_ret USING(store_id) ORDER BY 1

WITH dedup AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
  WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21'
  QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
  FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS net_sales FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1),
sale_days AS (SELECT s.store_id, count(DISTINCT f.sale_date) AS days_with_sales FROM dedup f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE s.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1),
trading AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, count(*) AS trading_days
  FROM dim_store cs
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' AND is_trading_day) d
  WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
    AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= d.calendar_date)
    AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= d.calendar_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND d.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ss.net_sales, t.trading_days, sd.days_with_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / t.trading_days, 2) AS net_sales_per_trading_day,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / t.trading_days DESC) AS rnk
FROM dim_store cs JOIN store_sales ss USING (store_id) JOIN trading t USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN sale_days sd USING (store_id)
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
ORDER BY net_sales_per_trading_day DESC
